desc: Read N, M, and array A (0-indexed positions).
Compute frequency `cnt[v]` and sum of positions `pos_sum[v]` for each value v in [0, M-1].
Implement Fenwick tree to compute `inv_0` (inversions of B when k=0) in O(N log M).
Re-derive and implement the correct delta for shifting k by 1.
Validate the transition formula with sample inputs to ensure correctness.
Output all M answers, one per line.
